meta.v2bAddText: CANONICAL CONDITION PHRASING: word every condition, in 12 words or fewer, as "<Loss-form> <capability>" using EXACTLY these loss-forms: "Complete loss of", "Partial loss of", "Erroneous", "Uncommanded", "Inadvertent", "Undetected". <capability> is the sub-function's own name recast as the delivered capability, the SAME words every time ("Provide wheel braking" -> TL "Complete loss of wheel braking", PL "Partial loss of wheel braking", M "Uncommanded wheel braking"). Add at most ONE short qualifier, two words or fewer, and only where a cell holds two distinct conditions that need telling apart ("— asymmetric", "— undetected"). Never synonymise loss-forms (no "total/full/gross loss", no "spurious/false" where Erroneous applies), never restate the mechanism, never exceed 12 words in a cell.
